passage:
The school changed its bell to a short song written by students. The music club held a contest, and the winning song was played between classes.
At first, students were proud. They stopped in the hallway to listen.
After a few weeks, the song became normal. Most students no longer noticed it.
One day, visitors from another school came and said, "Your bell is beautiful." Students heard it differently again.
The music teacher said this happens often. When something becomes part of daily life, people stop seeing its value.
The bell song reminded students that familiar things may still be special. Sometimes it takes visitors to make people notice what they already have.
